title: MEI Debt Forgiveness: Fiscal Impact and Cost Reduction
seoTitle: MEI Debt Forgiveness: Fiscal Impact, Cost Savings
subtitle: Complementary Bill Offers Relief for Individual Microentrepreneurs
excerpt: A proposed bill to forgive debts for Individual Microentrepreneurs (MEIs) is expected to have fiscal repercussions, but will also reduce operational costs for the segment.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A complementary bill proposing the forgiveness of debts for Individual Microentrepreneurs (MEIs) is expected to have a fiscal impact, but will also promote cost reduction.

According to the proposal, the measure aims to ease the financial burden on MEIs, while simultaneously leading to changes in public accounts due to revenue waivers.

Beyond the fiscal effect, the initiative is expected to result in a decrease in operational costs for microentrepreneurs, contributing to the sustainability of small businesses.

With information from Agência Brasil.
